zh: 你让 AI 帮你查查：昨晚发布的 xxx模型，大家都怎么评价。
en: You ask your AI: what are people saying about the xxx model that launched last night?
say: 你让 AI 帮你查查，昨晚发布的叉叉叉模型，大家都怎么评价。

zh: 它去 X，要登录。去知乎，弹验证码。Reddit，直接 403。
en: X wants a login. Zhihu throws a CAPTCHA. Reddit: straight 403.
say: 它去 X，要登录。去知乎，弹验证码。Reddit，直接四零三。

zh: 好不容易打开一页，几十万字符的 HTML 灌进来，上下文当场爆掉。
en: When a page finally opens, hundreds of thousands of characters of HTML pour in — and the context blows up.

zh: 最后它只能说：“抱歉，我无法访问这些网站。”
en: In the end, all it can say is: "Sorry, I can't access these sites."
say: 最后它只能说，抱歉，我无法访问这些网站。

zh: 可这些网站，你的浏览器里，全都登录着。
en: Yet your own browser is logged in to every one of them.

zh: Recursurf —— 让 AI agent 借你的浏览器上网。
en: Recursurf — let your AI agent browse the web through your own browser.
say: Recursurf。让 AI agent，借你的浏览器上网。

zh: 同一句话，再问一次。这回，它借你的浏览器，同时打开六个网站。
en: Same question, one more time. Now it borrows your browser and opens six sites at once.

zh: 交回来一份报告：哪里在夸，哪里在骂，跑分和实测哪里对不上。每一条，都带出处。
en: Back comes a report: who's praising, who's complaining, where benchmarks and real use disagree. Every point cited.

zh: 技术排查、新闻舆情、股票异动，也都是一句话的事。
en: Tech triage, public opinion, stock moves — each just one sentence away.

zh: Recursurf 的办法很直接：不另起一个浏览器，借你平时用的那个。
en: Recursurf's answer is simple: don't spin up another browser — borrow the one you already use.

zh: 比如 AI 想读一条知乎回答，只要敲一条 rsf 命令。
en: Say the AI wants to read a Zhihu answer. It just types one rsf command.

zh: 命令交给后台常驻的 daemon，它通过浏览器插件，在你的浏览器里开个标签。
en: The command goes to a background daemon, which — through a browser extension — opens a tab in your browser.
say: 命令交给后台常驻的 daemon，它通过浏览器插件，在你的浏览器里，开个标签。

zh: 几十万字符的页面，变成几行精简的文字，回到 AI 手里。
en: A page of hundreds of thousands of characters comes back to the AI as a few compact lines.

zh: 登录用的是你的，所以对网站来说，来的就是你本人。
en: It's your login — so to the website, it's simply you.

zh: 先看最常用的 rsf read：一个网页，讲了什么。
en: Start with the everyday tool, rsf read: what is this page about?
say: 先看最常用的，rsf read。一个网页，讲了什么。

zh: 一个 B 站视频页，原始 HTML 有二十三万字符。
en: A Bilibili video page: 230,000 characters of raw HTML.

zh: read 之后，只剩两千字，该有的一样不少。
en: After read: about 2,000. Everything that matters is still there.

zh: 标题、作者、播放数据，评论有多少条、怎么展开，一眼就清楚。
en: Title, author, stats, how many comments and how to expand them — all at a glance.

zh: 长文章只关心几件事？加上 grep，只取命中的段落，
en: Only care about a few things in a long article? Add --grep to keep just the matching passages,
say: 长文章只关心几件事？加上 grep，只取命中的段落。

zh: 还标出它在全文的位置，想接着读，用 offset 跳过去就行。
en: each tagged with its position, so --offset can pick up right there.

zh: 最妙的是结尾：读完页面，它还告诉 AI，这个网站有哪些现成的函数。
en: And the best part is at the end: it tells the AI which ready-made functions this site has.

zh: 每个网站的常用功能，都存成一个普通的 JS 文件。
en: Each site's common features live in a plain JS file.
say: 每个网站的常用功能，都存成一个普通的 JavaScript 文件。

zh: 函数签名就是说明书；注释里的例子，lib test 会真的跑一遍。
en: The signature is the manual; lib test actually runs the examples in the comments.
say: 函数签名就是说明书。注释里的例子，lib test 会真的跑一遍。

zh: 接口怎么调、哪里有坑，写进站点笔记，踩过一次就不用再踩。
en: How the API works and where the traps are go into site notes — step on a trap once, never again.

zh: 内置五十个网站：搜索、学术、社区、视频、新闻、金融，开箱即用。
en: 50 sites built in — search, research, forums, video, news, finance — ready out of the box.

zh: 有些活没有接口，只能一页页去填。比如新版本上架：三家应用市场，三套不一样的表单。
en: Some jobs have no API — just forms. Like shipping a new version: three app stores, three different forms.

zh: 要填的资料散在文件夹里：版本号、更新说明、软著编号、隐私政策，还有一堆截图。
en: The details are scattered across a folder: version, release notes, copyright number, privacy policy, and a pile of screenshots.

zh: AI 先把文件读一遍，再用 rsf tab list，找到你开着的三个后台。
en: The AI reads the files, then uses rsf tab list to find the three consoles you have open.

zh: rsf snapshot 看一眼页面：每个输入框都带编号，哪些必填，一目了然。
en: One rsf snapshot: every field gets a number, and the required ones are obvious.

zh: 一条 fill 填完一整页，截图用 upload 直接传上去。
en: One fill completes the whole page; upload sends the screenshots straight in.

zh: 按名字点“提交审核”？页面上有两个。它不瞎猜，把候选列出来。
en: Click "Submit for review" by name? There are two. It won't guess — it lists the candidates.
say: 按名字点提交审核？页面上有两个。它不瞎猜，把候选列出来。

zh: 换成编号点，返回值直接告诉它：弹了确认框，页面也跳走了。
en: Click by number, and the result says it all: a confirm dialog popped, and the page moved on.

zh: 第二家是三步向导。点完“下一步”，旧编号就作废，它会提醒 AI 重新看一眼。
en: Store two is a three-step wizard. After "Next", old numbers expire — and it tells the AI to look again.
say: 第二家是三步向导。点完下一步，旧编号就作废，它会提醒 AI 重新看一眼。

zh: 每个错误都带错误码和下一步该怎么做。这些输出，都是写给 AI 看的。
en: Every error carries a code and the next step. All of this output is written for an AI to read.

zh: 整个过程，trace 都录了下来：点了哪、填了什么、最后提交给了哪个接口。
en: trace records the whole run: what was clicked, what was filled, and which API it was finally submitted to.

zh: AI 照着录制写成脚本。下次发版，一条命令，三家一起填完。
en: The AI turns the recording into a script. Next release: one command, all three stores done.

zh: 函数和函数之间，可以用管道拼起来。
en: Functions snap together with pipes.

zh: B 站搜到的视频一行一条，流进下一个函数，评论就出来了。
en: Bilibili search results flow line by line into the next function — and out come the comments.

zh: 再往上一层，用 rsf run 写几行 JS，把好几个网站自由组合。
en: One level up, a few lines of JS in rsf run combine as many sites as you like.
say: 再往上一层，用 rsf run 写几行 JavaScript，把好几个网站自由组合。

zh: 回到开头那个问题，看看 AI 是怎么一步步查清楚的。
en: Back to the opening question — let's watch how the AI works it out, step by step.

zh: 第一步，广撒网：六个网站同时搜，结果规整成同一种格式。
en: Step one, cast a wide net: six sites searched at once, results normalized into one format.
say: 第一步，广撒网。六个网站同时搜，结果规整成同一种格式。

zh: B 站搜到的，不少是上一代模型的旧视频，AI 看一眼标题就跳过。
en: Many Bilibili hits are old videos about the previous model — the AI skips them by title.

zh: 第二步，深挖讨论。说法正好相反：有人说吊打一切，有人说是在刷榜。
en: Step two, dig into the threads. They contradict each other: 'it crushes everything' versus 'it's gaming the benchmarks'.
say: 第二步，深挖讨论。说法正好相反：有人说吊打一切，有人说，是在刷榜。

zh: 第三步，查一手资料：官方技术报告、公开榜单，还有网友的独立复测。
en: Step three, primary sources: the official technical report, public leaderboards, and an independent re-test.
say: 第三步，查一手资料。官方技术报告、公开榜单，还有网友的独立复测。

zh: 最后写出报告：矛盾的说法摆在一起，每一条都带出处。
en: Finally, write it up: conflicting claims side by side, every point cited.

zh: 中间结果都写进文件，哪一步都能单独重跑，上下文也不会被撑爆。
en: Intermediate results go to files — rerun any step, and the context never overflows.

zh: 摸通的网站存成函数，做过的流程存成脚本。用得越多，它就越熟悉这个互联网。
en: Sites it figures out become functions; jobs it has done become scripts. The more you use it, the better it knows the web.

zh: Recursurf —— 给 AI 一双能上网的手。
en: Recursurf — give your AI hands for the web.
say: Recursurf。给 AI，一双能上网的手。
